_comment: Starter regions for a new asset, in normalized coords (y down). Scaffolded by tools/cutout.py when an asset has no regions.json yet. These are a generic standing figure -- open the editor and drag to fit. The ellipse, not the region, is the unit of motion: each one carries its own amp/spd/delay, and a region's amp/spd is only what a new ellipse inherits.
